svg.text: the frozen VLM only ever sees the exact Recent-6 window plus at most 3 admitted history frames
older history: out of band, never scored
admissible band 3 s ≤ d ≤ 30 s → candidates
MMR: λ r_i − (1−λ) max_s sim(h_i, h_s)
S₀ = α M₀ + β E₀ + γ V₀
C_j: a close frame must support the new answer
P_j: answer changes, or S_j rises by ε
rejected state → rollback to last accepted prefix
MCQ and open-ended questions share one controller;
all signals come from the generated answer, never from options
